newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 28.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 3.49 points lower at 8,113.44 as the market took a breather after the week's series of record closing highs driven by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's comments about the economy.

* Property tycoon Ciputra said rupiah depreciation against the dollar would not hurt the local property sector as the rupiah had been expected to depreciate some five percent annually due to the central bank's gradual depreciation policy, Bisnis Indonesia daily reported on Monday.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index ended 1.99 points, or 0.28 percent, lower at 710.06 points due to worries over the rupiah and the likelihood of poor first half corporate earnings.
* On Monday, the rupiah was traded at 2,608.00/15.00 at 0145 GMT against an opening of 2,605.00/15.00.
* Sentul as the property firm is scheduled to be listed on Monday.
* Tin miner Timah after announcement of a drop in its first half net profit.
* Bank Papan Sejahtera and Langgeng Makmur Plastic Industry after the stock exchange suspended the firms in late trading on Friday.
* Bank BNI on a report in Bisnis Indonesia daily that it had completed the acquisition of Amsterdam-based Bank Indover.
* Soft drink manufacturer PT Suba Indah after reports it planned to resume producing liquor later this year.
* Bank Bira and Kalbe Farma after announcements of rises in their first half net profits.
* Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia on reports it expected to post poor first half results.
